title:
A green test suite
is only the beginning.
voice: AI coding agents can deliver a patch that passes every test, while quietly weakening security. Meet ForgeGuard: autonomous engineering, with proof.
caption: Passing tests alone cannot prove a patch is safe.

title: One task. Clear boundaries.
voice: Start with a repository, a branch, and a clear engineering task. In this explicitly enabled showcase, we add exponential backoff to checkout, while preserving the public API.
caption: Add retry handling. Preserve the public API.

title: Every patch earns its verdict.
voice: The engineer works in an isolated Git worktree. ForgeGuard captures the actual diff, runs deterministic checks, and sends the patch to independent security, scope, and adversarial reviewers.
caption: Isolated worktree → real diff → independent review

title: Tests pass. The patch is blocked.
voice: Here is the critical moment. The checkout tests pass, but the first patch also removes an authorization check. Independent evidence catches the unrelated regression, and ForgeGuard blocks the patch.
caption: A critical finding blocks the patch, even with passing tests.

title: Repair. Re-check. Verify.
voice: The repair agent restores the authorization boundary while keeping the retry implementation. ForgeGuard then runs the entire verification loop again. The repaired patch reaches a verified verdict.
caption: Bounded repair → fresh tests → fresh reviews → VERIFIED

title: A verdict you can inspect.
voice: Inspect the diff and the timestamped flight recorder. Then download the verification receipt: a portable record of the evidence, with SHA 256 hashes that let you check its integrity independently.
caption: Human-readable proof + downloadable SHA-256 receipt

title:
Your repositories.

accent: Live providers • Read-only audits • Repair Credits
voice: Beyond this showcase, ForgeGuard supports real repositories, provider-backed engineering, read-only security audits, and credit-authorized repair jobs. Production automation begins with a signed GitHub webhook.
caption: The showcase is opt-in. Live provider mode is the default.

title:

caption: Explore the code, run the demo, and inspect the evidence.
